messages:
kate: Quick heads-up: BlueRidge goes live with bulk import + live chat tomorrow at 14:00 UTC. Their renewal score is borderline (NPS=5) so we want a smooth first 72h. Suggest a prefill + transient warm pool and a lightweight in-app pulse at 48h.

jorge: What are the expected patterns? bursty or steady?

kate: bursty. import job sends ~200 r/s to /batch/generate for ~20m with avg seq=250. chat normally 5 r/s, bursts to 50 r/s for a few minutes.

emily: For this profile I recommend: 1) prefix cache for repeated system prompts (TTL=45s), 2) KV caching for chat persona context, 3) batch window=45ms with jitter=0.12, 4) warm_workers=6 for 30 minutes around import.

li: Add streaming-first for chat so users see tokens while backend finishes. Also have a rollback rule to reduce batch.window to 20ms and throttle clients by IP if we see queue_depth>70%.

jorge: Can you share the warmup command so I can schedule it in ops? Also want to avoid hitting their origin during prefill.

kate: paste below. limit prefill_rate and stagger tenants where possible.
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RID" \
  -d '{"tenant":"blueridge","routes":["/batch/generate","/chat"],"prefill_size":400,"prefill_rate":40}'
```

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job created: id=prefill-2025-07-21-br-01 run_at=1799004000

emily: Observability checklist: emit events prefill.start, prefill.done, cache.hit_rate, batch.window_ms, batch.p95, stream.first_byte_ms, fallback.switch_count. Tag tenant with renewal_risk=watch and survey_context=import_run.

li: Alerting: create a short-window alert (3m) for p99>1200ms OR error_rate>4% that triggers routing to quantized_small and enables streaming_partial. Also add a runbook link in the alert.

jorge: Ownership: I'll run the prefill and monitor live. @emily will add metrics and alerts, @kate will do customer comms and the 48h pulse.

kate: I'll draft the pulse: 2-question in-app — thumbs up/down + optional comment. If negative, auto-create ticket with tag priority=renewal-risk and notify account owner.

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job started: id=prefill-2025-07-21-br-01 status=running

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job completed: id=prefill-2025-07-21-br-01 status=success duration=26s prefilled=394

jorge: Quick check: cache hit_rate ~79%, batch.p95=340ms, stream.first_byte=110ms, no fallbacks triggered.

emily: Looks healthy. I'll leave warm pool for +20m and then scale down. Will also annotate the Confluence runbook with the exact alert thresholds and sample queries.

kate: Thanks team. If we see any sustained degradation we'll switch to the fallback policy (route to low-memory quantized variant) and open the renewal playbook. Closing thread unless issues pop up. :white_check_mark:
